Needs(Rabbit, Lion, True) ::: The rabbit needs the lion.
Visits(Rabbit, BaldEagle, True) ::: The rabbit visits the bald eagle.
Visits(Rabbit, Bear, True) ::: The rabbit visits the bear.

Rules:
Visits($x, Rabbit, True) >>> Needs($x, Bear, True) ::: If someone visits the rabbit then they need the bear.
Needs($x, Rabbit, True) >>> Likes(Rabbit, Bear, True) ::: If someone needs the rabbit then the rabbit likes the bear.
Visits($x, Bear, True) && Needs(Bear, Rabbit, True) >>> Needs($x, Bear, True) ::: If someone visits the bear and the bear needs the rabbit then they need the bear.
Needs($x, Bear, True) >>> Needs($x, Rabbit, True) ::: If someone needs the bear then they need the rabbit.
Needs(Bear, Lion, True) && Likes(Bear, BaldEagle, True) >>> Visits(Bear, BaldEagle, True) ::: If the bear needs the lion and the bear likes the bald eagle then the bear visits the bald eagle.
Blue($x, True) && Likes($x, BaldEagle, True) >>> Needs(BaldEagle, Rabbit, True) ::: If someone is blue and they like the bald eagle then the bald eagle needs the rabbit.
Likes($x, Bear, True) >>> Visits(Bear, Rabbit, True) ::: If someone likes the bear then the bear visits the rabbit.
Likes(BaldEagle, Rabbit, True) && Visits(BaldEagle, Rabbit, True) >>> Needs(BaldEagle, Bear, True) ::: If the bald eagle likes the rabbit and the bald eagle visits the rabbit then the bald eagle needs the bear.
Likes(Rabbit, Bear, True) >>> Visits(Bear, BaldEagle, True) ::: If the rabbit likes the bear then the bear visits the bald eagle.

Query:
Likes(Bear, BaldEagle, False) ::: The bear does not like the bald eagle.
